name: EmptyState
description: A block that stands in for missing content: muted icon, title, description and up to three actions, in an inline or route-level scale.

fields.titleStyle: TextStyle? - merged onto the size's title style
fields.descriptionStyle: TextStyle? - merged onto the size's description style
fields.padding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - null = the size's entry (24 compact / 32 full page)
fields.metrics: Map<EmptyStateSize, EmptyStateMetrics>? - a listed size wins as a whole
fields.surface: ThemedColor? - compact surface fill; null = the ambient card token

notes: Default strings come from `primitives/localizations` (six new getters, English fallback only, no invented translations).
`emptyStateThemeTokens` and `EmptyStateThemeSchema` are deleted: one `EmptyStateTheme` with a per-size `EmptyStateMetrics` table replaces the second hand-maintained theme layer.
`EmptyStateTheme` now implements `Mergeable`; the old one extended `ComponentThemeData` without a merge, so a leg that set only `iconColor` dropped every other value.
`EmptyStateActionStyle` (primary/secondary/link) is gone: `EmptyStateAction.variant` takes a `ButtonVariant`, so the component no longer keeps its own parallel enum.
